newsitem.title: USA: Orange Cty, Calif., judges seek more funds - paper.
newsitem.headline: Orange Cty, Calif., judges seek more funds - paper.

text.p: Orange County, Calif., judges have threatened to seek court orders forcing the county to provide millions of dollars in additional funding, according to a published report on Thursday.

Theodore Millard, the presiding judge of the Orange County Superior Court, said the judges have set a March 21 deadline to give their lawyers time to draw up the orders, the Los Angeles Times reported.
The judges maintain that the county courts will run out of money in early May without additional funding.
The courts originally said $18.9 million was needed, but during talks this week the judges said the courts could get by with $13.9 million, the Times reported.
